domain.description: DNS domain for the school network (required for LDAP/AD integration)

ntp_servers.description: List of NTP servers to sync time with

ldap_server_uri.description: URI of LDAP server (must include scheme: ldap:// or ldaps://)

ldap_root_bind_password.description: Password for LDAP admin user (leave blank for debconf-secret)

primary_school_name.description: Human-readable name of the school (displayed in UIs)

cups_server.description: Hostname of the central CUPS print server

nfs_server.description: Hostname of the NFS server for home directories

nfs_home_path.description: Path exported by NFS server for user home directories

winbind_enabled.description: Enable Active Directory integration via Winbind

winbind_ad_server.description: Hostname or IP of Active Directory domain controller

winbind_admin.description: AD username with rights to join machines to the domain

winbind_admin_password.description: Password for AD join account (use secure debconf entry in production)

lts_server.description: Hostname of the LTSP (diskless workstation) server

lts_root_path.description: Path on the LTSP server containing the root filesystem for clients

ltsp_client_arch.description: Architecture used for LTSP client images (i386, amd64, arm64)

ltsp_nbd_enabled.description: Use NBD instead of NFS to serve the LTSP root filesystem

ltsp_swap_size_mb.description: Swap partition size (in MiB) for diskless clients (0 = disable swap)

ltsp_client_options.description: Additional key=value options to inject into LTSP client initrd

firewall_rules.description: Path to custom firewall rules file

backup_user.description: Remote user account for backup transfers

backup_destination_path.description: Remote path where backups are stored

backup_frequency.description: Backup schedule frequency: daily, weekly, or monthly

monitoring_enabled.description: Enable local monitoring via Nagios/Icinga agent

monitoring_snmp_community.description: SNMP community string for local system monitoring
